test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

Suman will be fired __if she did not complete the delegated target__ set by her boss.

options.text: if she do not complete the delegated target
if she had not complete the delegated target
if she does not complete the delegated target

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. if she does not complete the delegated target .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the** first conditional**, which is used to talk about real or possible situations in the future.
 
• The structure of the first conditional is "If + present simple, will + base verb".
 
• In a first conditional sentence using **"If"** with a real future situation, the correct form of the **verb** to use is **"will"** for the result clause and **present simple** for the condition clause.
 
 
• For example: I **will** fail if I **don't **study.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this question, the verb form is **'will' **and hence, **present simple tense** (does not complete) is grammatically correct.

Correct sentence: *Suman will be fired if she **does not complete** the delegated target set by her boss*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2nd Conditional Sentence:**

 
 
• **Structure:** If + Past Simple, would + base verb.
 
• **Example:** If I were an astronaut, I would look at the stars all the time.
 
• **Usage: **Describes hypothetical situations in the present or future.
 
 
 
• **3rd Conditional Sentence:**
 
 
• **Structure: **If + Past Perfect, would have + past participle.
 
• **Example: **If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
 
• **Usage: **Refers to unreal past situations and their imagined outcomes.
